newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Trade very slow in the panhandle late Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.
Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 100 head slaughter heifers; 4,900 head confirmed for week to date.
Heifers - pen select, few choice 2-3 1100 lbs 66.00.
Confirmed: 100 Week Ago: None Year Ago: 3,300
Wk to Date: 4,900 Week Ago: 11,800 Year Ago: 46,000
